name: Research Techniques in Biomedical Engineering
description: This course equips students with foundational and applied knowledge in biomedical engineering, covering physiological systems, sensors, biomedical circuits, and clinical diagnostics. Students gain hands-on skills in PCB design, signal processing, and medical imaging, while also exploring emerging technologies, research methodologies, biostatistics, and ethical practices in biomedical research and healthcare innovation.
